# pkguard

> Scan package-manager settings and advisories across a folder of repos. Rust binary. `pkguard scan` does not write files.

## Install

```
cargo install --git https://github.com/jackmcpickle/pkguard pkguard
```

Requires a stable Rust toolchain. Homebrew and prebuilt binaries are not published yet. The old npm package was named mailclad and shipped as 0.1.x. That was the Bun build. It does not match these docs.

## Commands

See https://pkguard.dev/docs/commands/scan for flags from the binary (`pkguard dump-catalog`).
